# Minimal SMB2 NEGOTIATE exchange, post-NetBIOS framing.
# The replayer masks the client GUID bytes because Smb2Connection generates a fresh GUID per run.
# Client advertises SMB3 encryption and SMB 3.1.1 preauth/encryption negotiate contexts.
client -> FE 53 4D 42 40 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 24 00 05 00 01 00 00 00 40 00 00 00 33 22 11 00 55 44 77 66 88 99 AA BB CC DD EE FF 70 00 00 00 02 00 00 00 02 02 10 02 00 03 02 03 11 03 00 00 01 00 06 00 00 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 02 00 06 00 00 00 00 00 02 00 02 00 01 00
server -> FE 53 4D 42 40 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 01 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 41 00 00 00 02 02 00 00 44 33 22 11 66 55 88 77 99 AA BB CC DD EE FF 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
